method: Interactive native WeftForge window, macOS Open and Save panels, egui menus, command search, inspector and built-in workspace PNG capture. A private application bundle hard-linked the verified executable for macOS application selection.
pocket_import: Started with Untitled.weftforge, revision 0, 0 pieces. Used File > Import garment OBJ… and selected Pocket in millimetres.obj.

Before choosing a unit, the review displayed Millimetres, Centimetres, Metres and Inches. Import was disabled. Choosing Millimetres reported 1 OBJ unit = 1 mm, Y up, 1 exterior contour, 2 cutouts and 1 assigned fabric. Import became enabled.
Import committed revision 1 with 1 piece, 0 seams, 0 groups and 47 vertices. Undo returned to 0 pieces and 0 vertices at revision 2. Redo restored 1 piece and 47 vertices at revision 3.
Saved Pocket restored.weftforge, exported Pocket native.obj, reopened Pocket restored.weftforge at revision 3, used Frame all and saved Pocket workspace.png.
unsupported_input: With Pocket restored.weftforge open at revision 3, opened Import garment OBJ… from Commands and chose native-projected-faces-20261120/draped.obj. Choosing Metres reported OBJ garment requires a planar, uniformly scaled UV-to-XYZ mapping. Import remained disabled.
Cancel reported OBJ import cancelled; pending edits retained. The open pocket still had 1 piece, 0 seams, 0 groups, 47 vertices at revision 3. Saved separately as Pocket after refusal.weftforge.
harbor_import: Used File > New Empty. Typed Import garment into Commands and chose Import garment OBJ…. Selected native-obj-fabrics-20261120/Harbor.obj. Import was disabled before selecting Metres. Review then reported 1 OBJ unit = 1000 mm, Y up, 2 exterior contours, 0 cutouts and 2 assigned fabrics.

Import committed revision 1 with 2 pieces, 0 seams, 0 groups and 654 vertices. Scene showed piece_2 (#4) and piece_31 (#33). In Fabric properties the assignment for piece_31 was fabric_68_Terracotta_linen. Selecting piece_2 showed fabric_1_Cotton_approximation_uncalibrated.

Used Frame all. Saved Harbor imported.weftforge and exported Harbor native.obj. Saved Harbor workspace.png with piece_2 selected. The native capture showed separate blue and terracotta 2D patterns and their separated 3D planes.
pocket_corner_edit: Reopened Pocket restored.weftforge. Selected Hole #12 in Scene. Curve #17 exposed vertex #14 at U 0.080 m, V 0.240 m. Double-clicked the U field, typed 0.060 and pressed Return. Revision 4 had 44 vertices. The rebuilt cutout sloped at its left edge.

Saved Pocket edited corner.weftforge and exported Pocket edited corner.obj. Undo returned vertex #14 to U 0.080 m at revision 5 with 47 vertices. Redo restored U 0.060 m at revision 6 with 44 vertices. Saved Pocket edited redo.weftforge.

Reopened the revision-4 Pocket edited corner.weftforge. Hole #12 showed #14 at (0.060, 0.240) m, curve #17 applied length 121.655 mm, and pattern width 0.240 m and height 0.360 m. Framed and saved Pocket edited workspace.png.
scope: Measurements and input/output digests in NATIVE-MEASUREMENTS.json. Evidence covers WeftForge and original fixtures on the named macOS platform/build.
